purpose: Every score must identify what it measures, formula/source, evidence level, confidence, and reproducibility.

score_classes.hygiene_score: Measures cleanliness and organization, not product readiness.
score_classes.target_gap_score: Measures target-vs-current declared form, not necessarily runtime execution.
score_classes.operational_proof_score: Measures proof artifacts for actual work.
score_classes.trust_score: Measures independent validation and adversarial trust.
score_classes.readiness_score: Composite score, must list components and guards.

forbidden_score_claims: A score without metric_id is not canonical.
A score without inputs is opinion.
A score from one auditor is not consensus.
Profile baseline score must not be described as implementation readiness.
Receipt existence must not be described as receipt trust.
